title: Electrification of Inspection Quarter, Power House and Staff Quarters at Kanhoji Angre Island Lighthouse under Mumbai Directorate
summary: E-tender for supply and installation of electrical wiring, earthing, lighting, security lights and electrical gadgets (AC, solar water heater, solar refrigerator, binoculars) in the inspection quarter, power house and staff quarters at Kanhoji Angre Lighthouse, Khanderi Island, Raigad, Maharashtra.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

sites.name: Kanhoji Angre Lighthouse Station, Khanderi Island, Raigad, Maharashtra
sites.work: Electrification of inspection quarter, power house and staff quarters; tower wiring; security lights; electrical gadgets

scope.item: Copper plate earthing 600x600x3 mm for main DB with 25x3 mm copper strip
Surface wiring in inspection quarters, staff quarters and lighthouse tower with modular switches, sockets, MCB DBs
Cable laying: 2C/16 sq.mm flexible cable DG set to main DB; 3C/2.5 sq.mm main DB to security lights
Installation of 24W IP66 LED street light fittings with GI pipe L bracket on wall (security lights)
Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of air conditioning, solar water heater, solar refrigerator as per BoQ
Binoculars 16X zoom, 50 mm objective, waterproof, nitrogen filled

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (FDR/BG) before work order, valid 03 months beyond warranty (1 year 3 months from LoI); plus 5% security deposit deducted from each RA bill
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months from technical bid opening; originals by post/hand by 15.10.2025 15:00. MSME/NSIC registered bidders are also required to submit EMD. Percentage-rate BoQ. Water/electricity if arranged by owner recovered at 1% each of tender cost.

period.completion: 01 month from date of issue of work order
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with Central/State Govt/Municipal Corporation having tender limits >= estimated cost

Similar works (supply, installation of electrical works) in last 7 years: three works each >= Rs 4.14 lakh, or two each >= Rs 5.17 lakh, or one >= Rs 8.28 lakh; completion certificates from officer not below Executive Engineer; sub-contractor experience not considered
Average annual turnover at least 30% of estimated cost (Rs 3,10,466) in last 3 financial years ending 31.03.2025, CA certified
Valid Electrical Contractor Licence to work in Maharashtra State
PAN, GST registration, ITRs for FY 2022-23 to 2024-25
Bank solvency certificate for minimum Rs 4,13,955 issued within one year
Tender acceptance letter, unconditional-bid undertaking, bid securing declaration, notarised non-blacklisting affidavit, no-relatives declaration, Make in India self-certification
Technical evaluation: minimum 70/100 marks (financial standing 40, experience 40, performance 20)
specs: Wires: single core multi-stranded copper, PVC insulated FRLS, IS:694, 1100 V
MCBs 10 kA C-curve; RCCB 30 mA per IS 12640; double-door MCB DB with tinned copper busbar
Cables: copper, XLPE insulated, PVC sheathed armoured, IS:7098 (Part-I) 1.1 kV
Security lights: 24W IP66 LED street light fittings (4 Nos)
Binoculars: 16X, multi-layer coated, waterproof 1 m/5 min, 50 mm objective, 3.5 deg real FOV, 61 m at 1000 m, 177x196x68 mm

Approved makes include Finolex/Havells/Polycab wires, Legrand/Anchor Roma/Havells switches, Philips/Havells/Crompton lights, Hitachi/Daikin/Bluestar/Godrej/Voltas/LG split AC, Nikon/Canon/Sony/Celestron binoculars

unreadable: Hindi text layer garbled (font mojibake); English portions read

notes: BoQ stated as 'uploaded separately on website' and not included, so quantities for most items are not available. Site is an island reachable only by boat from Thal (Alibag)/Gateway of India jetty. Section IV/V GCC/SCC and Annexures are standard boilerplate. Special conditions notes mention paint/primer/putty makes, apparently copied from a civil tender. Television listed in approved makes though not described in scope.
